statuses.description: Source was reachable and returned records or a valid empty result.
Source is reachable but partial, stale, incomplete, or dependent on secondary archive coverage.
Source requires operator authentication, OAuth setup, or a provider token before capture can run.
Source refused or delayed capture because of rate limits or quota pressure.
Source access is technically or policy blocked for the current adapter.
Source endpoint is down, removed, or cannot be reached after bounded retry.
